---
id: env.excl.how-the-exclusions-apply
type: exclusion
heading: How the Exclusions Apply
since: 1.0.0
status: draft
---

We do not cover loss arising directly or indirectly from any of the matters in this section. The knowledge or conduct of one insured is not imputed to another insured for the purpose of any exclusion, as [[ref:env.cond.individual-treatment]] sets out. Where an endorsement shown in the schedule writes back cover for a matter excluded here, the endorsement applies to the extent it says.
